media.provenance: Local editorial brand tile checked against the official Replit product and brand pages; it is not represented as a product screenshot.

observedFacts.starter: Free; daily Agent credits; one published app with a 30-day publication window; one background task at a time.
observedFacts.core: $20 monthly reference price or $17/month billed annually; $20 toward the most powerful models; up to 5 collaborators; one active background task.
observedFacts.pro: $100 monthly reference price or $95/month billed annually; $100 toward the most powerful models; up to 15 collaborators; 10 parallel agents; 28-day database rollback.
observedFacts.enterprise: Custom pricing with organization security and control features.
observedFacts.billing: Paid Agent work uses effort-based pricing. Subscription credits also cover publishing, databases, storage, and other cloud services; some third-party AI services are deducted at the provider public API rate.
observedFacts.costControls: Paid work requires confirmation; usage alerts and budget limits are available. Usage data can take up to 30 minutes to appear.
observedFacts.productBoundary: Replit integrates AI building, browser development, Git, managed services, and publishing. A successful preview or Agent checkpoint is not evidence of production security, correctness, scalability, or portability.

bestFit: Founders and small teams validating a web application quickly in one browser workspace
Teams that value an integrated Agent, editor, Git, database, secrets, and publishing path
Projects that can measure Agent and cloud usage and retain an accountable technical owner
notIdealFor: Regulated or high-risk systems without independent architecture and security review
Teams requiring fully predictable seat-only costs or provider-independent infrastructure
Applications whose performance, deployment, data, and operations must remain deeply customized
trialProtocol: Build one bounded internal workflow rather than the final production system
Set a spending limit before using paid Agent modes
Connect Git and review every generated change and dependency
Test authentication, authorization, secrets, failure paths, backups, and rollback
Record Agent cost, cloud cost, repair time, escaped defects, and export effort

releaseDayChecks: Re-open the official pricing page and confirm Starter, Core, Pro, and Enterprise prices and included allowances
Re-open AI billing and publishing-cost documentation and confirm effort-based and shared-credit wording
Run production duplicate and fallback preflight with --as-of=2026-09-09 --online
Generate data/collection/replit-release.json with reviewedAt=2026-09-09 only after the checks pass
Run release in rollback mode before --commit
After deployment, verify both locales remain noindex and outside sitemap
